title: A fatal pact, death note and poison: How a rifle coach came to haunt Andhra family
content: A woman and her parents died after jumping into a river with her son. The woman accused a rifle shooting coach of harassing her and killing her husband. Her son survived the incident after being rescued from the river. The coach was arrested in Meerut after a special investigation team was formed. Police are investigating allegations of murder, threats, and financial control.

title: Rs 30 lakh a month for an intern? India’s trading firms are in a fierce talent war
content: In a bid to attract the brightest minds, high-frequency trading firms in India are ramping up intern compensation to unprecedented levels. This surge in hiring is influenced by stricter regulations on derivatives and a lull in equity market movements. Companies such as Quadeye and Graviton Research Capital are notably enhancing their internship packages, with global firms following suit to secure top quantitative talent from leading institutions.

title: Massive floods sweep through Nepal; several districts put on high alert
content: At least eight people died in massive flash floods that struck Nepal on Wednesday.  A sudden rise in the Bhotekoshi River caused widespread damage near the China border.  Vehicles and property were washed away in the Timure and Syafrubesi market areas.  Rescue operations are underway with army personnel deployed to affected regions.  The flooding was not caused by rainfall, officials confirmed.

content: The incident happened on the first day after Fernando dismissed Jaiswal. The India opener had hit three boundaries in the over before Fernando bowled him with a delivery that beat his defence.

title: Amazon shuts down its 21-yr-old platform that Bezos described as 'artificial AI'
content: Amazon has announced that it will shut down its Mechanical Turk platform on September 30, 2026. Once a vital link for hundreds of thousands seeking flexible digital tasks, the service has struggled against the rise of advanced AI technologies and new competitor platforms. Previously, Amazon aimed to pivot Mechanical Turk for its AI training requirements, but many users depended on it for remote income opportunities.

title: India’s 1st hydrogen train travels 6,000 km; cuts 36,444 kg CO2 emissions
content: India’s first hydrogen train consists of 10 coaches and can accommodate 2,600 passengers. It operates between Jind and Sonipat in Haryana with a maximum operating speed of 75 kmph, although the train has been designed to reach 110 kmph.

title: Why India’s rice exports to Iran may survive Trump's sanctions threat
content: India's rice exports to Iran are expected to continue despite tougher US sanctions.  Demand from Iran remains firm for food security reasons, ensuring continued purchases.  Indian exporters utilize alternative payment channels in countries like Turkey and the UAE.  Essential goods like rice and pharmaceuticals are unlikely to face disruption.  Bilateral trade has significantly declined from its previous peak levels.

title: Satya Nadella’s record pay signals Microsoft’s AI, cloud growth bet
content: In a landmark move, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has been awarded an unprecedented compensation package of $96.5 million, underscoring the firm’s strides in artificial intelligence and cloud services. This pay structure, predominantly reliant on stock and performance incentives, ties Nadella's earnings to both shareholder returns and overall revenue, aligning executive remuneration with crucial business objectives.

title: Watch: Gangajal in hand, UP councillors 'swear oath' to share bribes equally
content: A video shows Shahjahanpur Municipal Corporation councillors taking an oath to share civic funds. The purported oath states all income would be divided equally among sixty councillors. This viral video has prompted the civic body to order an official inquiry. The inquiry will investigate the authenticity of the video and its participants. Further action will be taken based on the inquiry's findings.

title: New pigment-free coating stays 6°C cooler than surrounding air in desert sun
content: Columbia Engineering researchers developed a porous polymer coating that can cool surfaces below the surrounding air temperature without using electricity. The coating replaces conventional white pigments with nano-to-microscale air voids that reflect sunlight and release heat towards the sky. Tests showed the surface stayed about 6°C below ambient temperature in Arizona and 3°C below it in Bangladesh.

title: Savannah Police audits 39,000 Flock searches; 6 employees fired, 4 arrested
content: Four former Savannah Police Department employees have been arrested over alleged misuse of the Flock Safety license plate reader system. The arrests followed an internal audit of 39,000 searches, which flagged 127 for review and found 34 were unjustified. Six employees were fired, while the Georgia Bureau of Investigation continues to investigate the case.

title: Google just told OpenAI and Anthropic, we taking the lawyers route' to come after you
content: Google has launched Gemini Enterprise for Legal, an innovative suite of AI tools designed to streamline legal workflows within law firms. This competitive offering aims to rival similar products from OpenAI and Anthropic, providing seamless integration with existing software while emphasizing data security. This development marks a pivotal moment for leading AI companies venturing into the legal sector.

title: ‘Be ready for cockroaches!’ CJP renews Sept 5 protest call over 3 pending demands
content: The Cockroach Janta Party plans a September 5 march in Delhi over unmet demands.  Three of four demands remain pending since the July 25 protest withdrawal.  The party seeks compensation and withdrawal of FIRs against student protesters.  Assurances were given by ministers after talks on July 25.  The march will proceed from India Gate to the Police Headquarters.

title: HAL, Safran seal engine deal to power multi-role choppers
content: HAL and Safran Helicopter Engines signed a contract for the Aravalli engine. This new engine will power India's proposed 13-tonne multi-role helicopter. The agreement covers design, development, manufacture, and lifecycle support. This collaboration marks a significant step towards self-reliance in aero-engine technologies. The Aravalli engine will also find applications in civil aviation missions.

title: How a family reunion in China ended in a 3-year prison term for artist Gao Zhen
content: Chinese artist Gao Zhen received a three-year prison sentence for his satirical artwork.  Authorities charged him with "infringing upon the reputation of heroes" for his art.  Gao's wife expressed deep disappointment and sadness over the unexpected conviction.  His supporters argue the artworks predate the law under which he was prosecuted.  The sentence highlights China's narrowing space for artistic and political expression.

title: Fourth-party audit? PM Modi flags quality check lapses in public projects
content: Chairing the monthly Pragati meeting on Tuesday, Modi is learned to have told the top bureaucrats that such things are “unacceptable” and the system won’t work like this. Modi reviewed six infrastructure projects across railway, road and power sectors, spanning nine states with a cumulative cost of over Rs 30,000 crore. He said infrastructure projects should be viewed and monitored as an integrated whole, rather than as isolated sections, stretches or packages.

title: Kriti Sanon's Raksha Bandhan ad removed amid backlash over actress' outfit
content: In response to public backlash, a jewellery brand has pulled its Raksha Bandhan advertisement featuring actress Kriti Sanon, whose outfit sparked controversy. Kriti stood by her clothing choice, highlighting the festival's emotional significance over fashion. The brand issued a heartfelt apology for any offense caused, reaffirming their reverence for Indian culture and traditions during this festive period.

title: BJP MLA's private Innova washed by fire brigade, video goes viral
content: A video shows a government fire brigade vehicle washing a BJP MLA's private car.  The incident occurred outside the official residence of MLA Ramniwas Shah in Singrauli.  Three fire brigade personnel were seen using a hose to spray water on the vehicle.  This alleged misuse of government resources has sparked social media attention.  Neither the MLA nor the department has issued an official statement yet.

title: MG Hector Tomahawk launched: Prices, range & more
content: JSW MG Motor India has launched the new Hector Tomahawk SUV.  This seven-seater vehicle offers both pure-electric and plug-in hybrid powertrains.  The electric version boasts a claimed 517 km range on a single charge.  It also features advanced connected technology and India's first Gen AI with karaoke.  The Hector Tomahawk is built on MG's new ADAPT platform supporting various electrified configurations.

title: 'Poor guy has been behind bars': Ex-Pakistan cricketer speaks out on Imran Khan

The group includes Indian cricket legends Sunil Gavaskar, Kapil Dev and Dilip Vengsarkar. The appeal followed concerns that a recent medical examination did not fully meet the directions issued by Pakistan's Supreme Court.

title: '3,000 raids, rats, cockroaches': How FDA chief is giving eateries a wake-up call
content: Tukaram Mundhe leads Maharashtra's aggressive food safety crackdown, inspecting thousands of food businesses.  His teams have conducted over 3,000 raids, suspending permits and uncovering numerous violations.  The campaign now targets loose edible oil sales, enforcing regulations from 2011.  Traders express concern over mandatory packaging, while the FDA cites adulteration risks.  The FDA seized over Rs 5 crore worth of edible oil during recent inspections.

title: Lunar eclipse on Raksha Bandhan? Sutak not needed for Rakhi in India
content: In 2026, as Raksha Bandhan coincides with a lunar eclipse, Indian celebrants needn't worry about observance requirements related to the astronomical event, as it will not be visible in the country. Instead, they can focus on following the traditional Muhurta for the festive rituals. This celestial event provides a backdrop for exploring themes of connection and protection among siblings, so prioritize strengthening those bonds over any eclipse-related concerns.

title: 'Hijab on their heads, not minds': Owaisi calls Allahabad HC ruling 'attack on Islam'

The court dismissed the petition on the grounds of insufficient religious documentation, emphasizing students had followed uniform rules while reiterating that no enforceable right is granted to change school dress policies.

title: Why private missile manufacturing could be a game changer for India's defence readiness
content: India's defense sector is expanding self-reliance in missile manufacturing. DRDO is transferring conventional missile technologies to private companies. This move allows domestic firms to undertake full-scale missile production. It aims to cut import dependence and boost indigenous value addition. The initiative strengthens India's position in the global missile export market.

This comprehensive support is designed to help residents rebuild their lives and advance sustainable farming initiatives for a more resilient future.

title: ‘Secure sea lanes indispensable’: India urges UN to safeguard key maritime routes
content: India called for collective international action to safeguard critical sea lanes and maritime infrastructure. Secure shipping routes are essential for uninterrupted movement of vital commodities globally. Conflicts and attacks on maritime routes threaten food and energy supplies worldwide. India stressed the need for unimpeded humanitarian access and objective supply chain assessments. Strengthening domestic agriculture and diversifying supply chains are crucial for food security.

title: Trump sends Saudi nuclear deal to Congress, keeps Israel normalisation as condition

Congress has ninety days to review the proposed thirty-year agreement for potential nuclear proliferation concerns. The deal facilitates US companies' involvement in Saudi Arabia's nuclear program development. Saudi Arabia's stance on Palestinian statehood remains a significant hurdle for normalization.

title: US halts visa appointments globally amid Trump's immigration crackdown

Immigrant visa applicants are being notified of rescheduled interviews due to this program. The government is also tightening restrictions on legal immigration and visa issuances. title: No one should engage in 'narrow politics': Mayawati on hijab row

title: Chennai Canvas: Madras Week Episode 4 | How cinema became part of Chennai
content: Cinema is woven into the fabric of Chennai’s cultural memory. From romance, longing and movie-inspired moments on the city’s beaches to the dramatic shift from celluloid reels to digital projection, Chennai’s relationship with the big screen has constantly evolved. At the heart of that journey are theatres that became landmarks in their own right, including Royapettah’s Pilot Theatre. Episode 4 of Chennai Canvas, for Madras Week, revisits these spaces, memories and technological changes to explore why, for generations of Chennai residents, the city and cinema have been inseparable.

title: Madras built the engine, Chennai is shifting gears

title: Cost of being parentless: Odisha rights panel orders probe into wrong parents’ names in certificates
